retained_failures_and_limits: Fresh default full-source model still omitted both performer links; AFFECTED and CAUSED proposals are not evidence of complete roles.
Lexical occurrence cues and exact source presence do not certify action meaning, date role, causation or legal liability.
The new exception is bounded to supported French/English past constructions; unknown wording/languages and ambiguous evidence require review.
The shared boundary check corrects source-date substring matching in profile-occurrence; older actor-word exceptions are not a universal semantic validator.
No historical graph migration, new upstream release, Laya training/timing, GLiNER comparison, Docker/mobile or real-contract certification in this pass.
training_implication: Label source presence, occurrence, entity/category, date role, performer connection and human acceptance separately. An encoder cannot repair downstream event registration; compare shortlist recall and full-source fallback independently.
